lead_html:
1. What this is: every picture Gimme Some Slack draws in the game — 111 rows, one per part per look (Scrapper, Industrial, Modern, Futuristic; Modern cords also per colour), each at its true in-game size beside a human, the same part's looks banded together. The power-tap clamp is first; the last 40 rows are hose art that moved to FlowWorks.
2. What you rule on: for each picture in each look, keep it or redo it (say why in the note). The clamp rows also hold the new clamp candidates — pick one per look.
3. Your clicks save automatically. The blue IN GAME frame is only the agent's starting point (a prefill, counted separately), never your choice; nothing installs until you say the sheet is done.
New clamp candidates, in place: each one biting its own look's real ground cord, 128 px per cell (grid lines = cells; the clamp draws 1.5 cells wide). Pick on the clamp rows below.
